Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/iommu/iommu-sva.c`**
- The code block that handles the binding of a device to an SVA (Shared Virtual Addressing) domain has been modified.
- The lines that set the reference count for the handle and add the handle to the list of SVA handles have been moved from before the `out` label to after it. This change ensures that these operations are executed even when an existing domain is found in a multi-device case.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug where the SVA handle was not being shared correctly in scenarios involving multiple devices. By moving the `refcount_set` and `list_add` operations to the `out` section, the patch ensures that the handle is properly shared regardless of whether an existing domain is found, thus fixing the issue introduced in a previous commit (identified by the fix reference).

content: You are a programming expert.

You will be given the root cause of a bug, the commit message and the corresponding patch.
        You need to extract all code statements that lead to the bug from the patch, based on the root cause and the commit message.

        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by the `iommu_sva_bind_device` function prematurely exiting in the case of finding an existing domain in a multi-device scenario. This led to the failure of the handle to be shared, as the necessary operations to set the reference count and add the handle to the list were skipped.
        
        Commit message:
        iommu/sva: Fix SVA handle sharing in multi device case

iommu_sva_bind_device will directly goto out in multi-device
case when found existing domain, ignoring list_add handle,
which causes the handle to fail to be shared.

Fixes: 65d4418c5002 ("iommu/sva: Restore SVA handle sharing")
Signed-off-by: Zhangfei Gao <zhangfei.gao@linaro.org>
Reviewed-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>
Reviewed-by: Lu Baolu <baolu.lu@linux.intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Kevin Tian <kevin.tian@intel.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240227064821.128-1-zhangfei.gao@linaro.org
Signed-off-by: Joerg Roedel <jroedel@suse.de>  
        
        Patch:
        diff --git a/drivers/iommu/iommu-sva.c b/drivers/iommu/iommu-sva.c
index 7f91c8d0064b..65814cbc8402 100644
--- a/drivers/iommu/iommu-sva.c
+++ b/drivers/iommu/iommu-sva.c
@@ -117,11 +117,11 @@ struct iommu_sva *iommu_sva_bind_device(struct device *dev, struct mm_struct *mm
 	if (ret)
 		goto out_free_domain;
 	domain->users = 1;
-	refcount_set(&handle->users, 1);
 	list_add(&domain->next, &mm->iommu_mm->sva_domains);
-	list_add(&handle->handle_item, &mm->iommu_mm->sva_handles);
 
 out:
+	refcount_set(&handle->users, 1);
+	list_add(&handle->handle_item, &mm->iommu_mm->sva_handles);
 	mutex_unlock(&iommu_sva_lock);
 	handle->dev = dev;
 	handle->domain = domain;
--
